Butizide (rINN)  Buthiazide (USAN); Butitsidi; Butizid; Butizida; Butizidum; Isobutyl- hydrochlorothiazide; Thiabutazide. 6-Chloro-3,4-dihydro-3-iso- butyl-2H-1,2,4-benzothiadiazine-7-sulphonamide 1,1-dioxide. Бутизид C11H16ClN3O4S2 = 353.8. CAS — 2043-38-1. Profile Butizide is a thiazide diuretic with properties similar to those of hydrochlorothiazide (p.1307). It is used for oedema, including that associated with heart failure (p.1165), and for hypertension (p.1171). Butizide is given orally, usually with spironolactone; the usual maintenance dose for oedema or hypertension is 5 to 10 mg dai- ly. It has also been given with other antihypertensive drugs.
